cause_quote: The new Pinned section selected rows with `return row && row.archived !== true && !archiveVisibility?.(row.key) ? [row] : [];`, which let a pin with a future wake time remain visible.
user_saw: After snoozing a pinned session, its row stayed visible in Pinned on the Active sidebar.
summary: The fix hides snoozed pins from Pinned, keeps them discoverable through Snoozed and All, and restores them in saved order when they wake.
reasoning: The parent already filtered snoozed rows out of the ordinary Active list and displayed personal pins as rail shortcuts. PR #178066 introduced a dedicated Pinned section with its own row selection, and its original archive-only predicate bypassed the existing snooze filter.
